execution.reason: The API is runtime-enforced as retrieval-only by decision_gate.py; production approval and automatic identity confirmation remain blocked until the promotion evidence passes.

benchmark.dataset: six project MOV files; three new multi-person videos produced 395 person crops and 57 raw track fragments
benchmark.split: project same-camera temporal track-heldout plus CHIRLA per-query same-camera and same-sequence gallery exclusion
benchmark.projectGroundTruthScope: 10 manually reviewed stable tracks; identity is valid only inside each source track

rawArtifacts.localMirrorScope: aggregate legacy runs, ten fair strict run JSONs with 95 per-query rankings each, manifests, logs, checkpoint and hashes

promotionBlockedUntil: the same independently reviewed people are labeled across at least two project cameras or events
strict cross-camera Rank-1 and its 95% confidence lower bound both reach 0.85
Recall@5 reaches 0.95 and false-match/false-reject thresholds pass on an untouched test split

requiredInputs: identityGroupId when cross-camera identity is known
reviewed attributes and identity match labels
forbidLeakageAcrossSplits: same cameraId when the camera event is identity-correlated
adjacent frames from the same video event
requiredMetrics: JSON valid rate for any generative review output

localProxyResult.split: deterministic image-level 5-fold; no identity or track IDs
localProxyResult.metric: mean of per-field multiclass top-1 validation accuracies

attributeRecognition.metricWarning: External PA-100K mA/InsF1 is not the same metric as the local six-field per-field top-1 mean. The 85% project gate requires a real CCTV track-held-out rerun with mA, InsF1 and track-level exact match.

distillationArms.name: student_CLIP_hard
distillationArms.promotionReason: best embedded-scope result; ties resolved by lower complexity and measured latency

distillationArms.name: student_CLIP_soft_ensemble
distillationArms.strategy: CLIP features with CLIP/Qwen soft targets
distillationArms.promotionReason: hard labels reached 1.00 proxy accuracy while soft targets reached 0.40

distillationArms.name: student_CLIP_extended_variants
distillationArms.strategy: label smoothing, DINO hint, SupCon, prototype, KNN, confidence gates, KD temperatures and agreement gates
distillationArms.promotionReason: no reproducible gain over the hard-label CLIP student on the current proxy

distillationArms.name: student_FUSED_variants
distillationArms.strategy: CLIP plus DINO features with hard or soft targets
distillationArms.promotionReason: no measurable embedded benefit that justifies extra feature and deployment complexity

backendArms.name: solider_swin_b_attribute_plus_qwen_deterministic_fusion
components: SOLIDER Swin-B pedestrian attribute recognition head
SOLIDER or TransReID-family person ReID embedding
Qwen3-VL-8B only for conflict explanation and low-confidence review
backendArms.reason: A fair strict GPU rerun of CLIP B/32, CLIP L/14, DINOv2, SigLIP2, OSNet, FastReID SBS and four SOLIDER variants selected SOLIDER-ReID Swin-B at Rank-1 0.4737, Recall@5 0.7789 and identity-MRR 0.6074. The earlier 0.6421 result used an overlapping gallery. SOLIDER is enabled only for Top-K retrieval because the 0.85 automatic-match gate did not pass; Qwen is not used as the primary calibrated identity classifier.

backendArms.name: qwen3vl_8b_historical_baseline
backendArms.reason: retained only as the historical Qwen-centered comparison arm; it is not the selected calibrated attribute classifier and is not an automatic fallback

backendArms.name: qwen_plus_gemma_runtime_ensemble
backendArms.reason: Only separate model outputs were measured on the small crop proxy; the runtime ensemble itself has not been evaluated on the same CCTV track split.

runtimePolicy.dinoRole: offline geometry/retrieval teacher or optional server retrieval baseline
runtimePolicy.samRole: offline mask and track generation; never a replacement for the embedded student
runtimePolicy.florenceRole: offline attribute-label candidate; not enabled as a second runtime generator
runtimePolicy.sonnetRole: offline Claude CLI attribute annotation pilot only; no CHIRLA identity arm was run and provider training-use terms still require approval

recordingWorkerRuntime.appearance: CLIP ViT-L/14 holistic plus prompt contrast
recordingWorkerRuntime.attributeGate: ROI color plus SOLIDER-PAR; CLIP PETA/PA100k fallback
recordingWorkerRuntime.identity: SOLIDER reference or case-anchor; attribute-first without anchor
recordingWorkerRuntime.historicalRetrieval: case gallery when identity anchor is available
recordingWorkerRuntime.trackFusion: temporal and spatial consistency with availability-aware late fusion
recordingWorkerRuntime.qwenReview: top-K local Qwen review when QWEN_PROVIDER=qwen and checkpoint is ready

autoMatchRequires: server ReID embedding and calibrated same/different score present
sufficient observed frames and image quality
no model disagreement or multi-view conflict
